root_idea.summary: The root expresses completeness, fullness, and sufficiency, especially when something extends fully in breadth or length.
root_idea.development: The evidence develops fullness into extended or full coverage, abundant provision, fully performed actions, complete benefits, and full-covering armor, while also showing specialized bodily, anatomical, and reproductive usages.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed as the normalized Form IV perfect verb.
Displayed under the supported singular active-participle citation form.

senses.definition: To bestow fully and abundantly, especially to bestow blessings in full measure.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic usage, the verb governs divine blessings bestowed upon people and emphasizes their completeness and abundance.

senses.definition: Complete, ample, and long; specifically, a full-covering coat of mail.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quran uses the feminine plural form substantively for coats of mail, describing armor that is broad, complete, and sufficiently long.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be complete, full, ample, or long; of a garment, hair, or another thing, and in an expression for a horse's rib, to be full-length.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The same fullness branch is used of a benefit or boon becoming ample.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of rain, to approach the earth and extend or spread.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or extended use describing rain as reaching downward and spreading.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To tend toward and reach one's town or country.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic construction with لِـ marking the destination.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cast young abortively or in an incomplete state.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of a camel or other pregnant female; the source also applies it when the fetus's hair or fur has grown.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a thing complete, full, ample, wide, or long.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied especially to a garment or similar object, and to hair when made long; this is the general causative fullness use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To provide someone fully for their needs, or to expend upon them what is completely sufficient.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A construction describing ample provision or expenditure for another person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To perform an ablution completely, giving each member its due and making the washing reach its proper places.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional religious-ritual construction with الوضوء.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put on a wide, ample, or long coat of mail.
Plentifulness, pleasantness, ease, and softness or delicacy of life.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression سَبْغَةٌ مِنَ العَيْشِ for a life of plentiful and comfortable circumstances.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Complete, full, ample, or long; of a garment, coat of mail, tail, bucket, or another thing; also copious of rain and full or ample of a benefit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are established adjectival applications of the same fullness and extension branch, including descriptions of armor and other objects.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In established bodily descriptions, full or without defect in an udder, and without deficiency and long in the ribs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applies in the cited expressions سَابِغَةُ الضَّرْعِ and سَابِغَةُ الضُّلُوعِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Long of buttock; of a man, large in the buttocks.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical use in descriptions of the buttocks.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a stallion, long in the veretrum.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical description of a male animal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a gum, foul or ugly.
More or most complete, full, ample, or free from deficiency in breadth and length.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as a comparative or superlative adjective, including in a description of a coat of mail.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A piece of mail joined to a helmet that protects the neck; also mail forming the lower fringe of a helmet.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The descriptions vary on whether this piece is identical with the رَفْرَف, but agree on its armor-related neck protection.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man wearing a coat of mail of the ample, full-covering type.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal description of a person equipped with سَابِغَةٌ armor.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A young animal cast by its mother after the soul has been blown into it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized passive-participial term for the young so cast.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel that habitually casts her young abortively.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare or little-known term for this reproductive condition.
